blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — The Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Zamboanga del Sur is investigating the mining operations of company called TVI Resource Development Philippines Inc. (TVIRD) in Bayog town. It is zeroing in on the firm’s environmental compliance, tax liabilities, and mineral transport transparency. The provincial board’s Ad Hoc Committee, chaired by 2nd District Board Member Hernan dela Cruz, is examining the operations at TVIRD’s Balabag Gold-Silver Project. The panel wants to verify the production output of the business enterprise and look into the distribution of benefits to affected Indigenous Peoples (IPs).
